entities.summary: Mykhail Semenko or Mykhailo Vasyliovich Semenko was a Ukrainian poet, and a prominent representative of the Ukrainian Futurist movement of the 1920s. He was a leading figure of the Executed Renaissance — a generation of Ukrainian poets, writers, and artists persecuted by the Soviet regime.
